completion_promises.criterion_text: Mic button joins the input row behind `_sending`/`_ended`; press-to-record, press-to-send with an elapsed indicator; **one turn at a time** — pressing mic while a send is in flight does nothing.
completion_promises.evidence: Implementation complete in app/lib/ui/session_screen.dart. Mic button with Icons.mic/Icons.stop states, _recording flag, elapsed indicator, and onPressed guard (_sending || _ended || _voiceUnavailable) prevents interaction when disabled. AC-001 tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: On send, the transcript enters the session list **first**, exactly like a typed turn, then the tutor's spoken answer follows.
completion_promises.evidence: Implementation in _sendVoiceTurn() adds transcript as first TurnEntry, then tutor answer as second TurnEntry, preserving order. AC-002 tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `VoiceUnavailable` → amber notice with the verbatim copy *"Spoken answers aren't available right now — text still works"*; the mic stays **visible but disabled for the rest of the session** until a retry succeeds; typed turns are unaffected.
completion_promises.evidence: VoiceUnavailable catch block sets _voiceUnavailable=true and displays amber Container with exact copy. Mic button remains visible but onPressed is null when _voiceUnavailable. AC-003 tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Transport error keeps the existing `showConnectionProblem` treatment — recording preserved, retry = resend.
completion_promises.evidence: TransportError catch in _sendVoiceTurn() calls showConnectionProblem(context), preserving existing error handling. Recording data not cleared, allowing retry. AC-004 tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Recording without microphone permission explains it needs mic access and **does not fail** — typing still works.
completion_promises.evidence: Try-catch in _toggleMic() around recorder.start() catches permission errors and sets _voiceErrorMessage='This app needs microphone access to record your questions'. Typing functionality unchanged. AC-005 implementation verified.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Each refusal error type surfaces a plain-terms message and the app stays ready to record again immediately.
completion_promises.evidence: Catch blocks for all 5 refusal errors (UnsupportedAudioFormat, EmptyRecording, UnintelligibleQuery, QueryTooLong, RecordingTooLarge) each set plain-terms _voiceErrorMessage. Error cleared on next recording attempt. AC-006 tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The mic is disabled along with the rest of the input once the session has ended.
completion_promises.evidence: Mic button onPressed uses guard (_sending || _ended || _voiceUnavailable) ? null : _toggleMic, ensuring mic is disabled when _ended flag is set by _endSession(). Fixed test setup in turn 6 to create sessions before testing. AC-007 tests pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Typing a question still works exactly as before (regression — nothing about typed tutoring changes).
completion_promises.evidence: _send() method unchanged from original implementation. TextField and send button functionality preserved. Voice features added alongside, not replacing, text input. Fixed test in turn 6. AC-008 tests pass.
